note: The closed lists and texts of scripts/place_answers.py (spec t-1991 U1). Closed variety lives here, never in code (FR-13). Code checks keys, joins and presence of an answer; whether the answer is TRUE is the analyst's judgment, accepted by the scribe (AR-29).
answers_note: bug: the stand showed a break of a stated expectation; not_a_bug: the stand showed it is fine; requirement_silent: no requirement decides it, a question for the person who decides (never a bug); impossible: the stand cannot show it, with why.
sources_note: requirement: an R of the register; question: a question the person settled; person: the person's recorded words that reached THIS dispatch; none: no expectation (never for a bug).
place_id_note: req-<R> a register row; case-<C> / obs-<dispatch>-<i> an investigation target; draft-<stem> a draft of no other place; new-<slug> the analyst's own suspicion (slug 1-40 of a-z 0-9 -).
terminal_note: AR-22: fields the record carries and no reader consumes yet: written_at (when), walk (the walk id, filled when the walk session is used), replaces (the sha256 of the answer a --replace overwrote).
gap_reasons: the analyst's dispatch ended without an answer for this place
the stand could not be reached
the walk session could not be opened
the analyst was not dispatched: no failure to triage
the analyst was not dispatched: every failure had a state the run recorded

gap_reason_names.unanswered: the analyst's dispatch ended without an answer for this place
gap_reason_names.stand: the stand could not be reached
gap_reason_names.session: the walk session could not be opened
gap_reason_names.no_failures: the analyst was not dispatched: no failure to triage
gap_reason_names.pretriaged: the analyst was not dispatched: every failure had a state the run recorded

gap_reason_names_note: The driver picks a gap reason by NAME (story_run.s7_gap_reason), never by position; the same five texts as gap_reasons (a test pins the equality).
gap_target_note: A place whose register chain the analyst withdrew cannot take another line; when it is unsettled again its gap is written under this prefix + the place id, so the suspicion always has a register line.

state_texts.conflict: the analyst's answer and its own records disagree: {why}
state_texts.carrier_missing: the analyst's answer did not reach its record: {why}

line_texts.requirement_silent_why_not_a_bug: the requirements are silent on this; the person who decides the expected behaviour answers it
line_texts.impossible_why_not_a_bug: the analyst could not check it on the stand
line_texts.impossible_statement: the stand could not show this place
line_texts.withdraw_reason: the analyst answered bug; the draft carries it
line_texts.gap_why_not_a_bug: a suspicion nobody settled on the stand; it is neither a bug nor cleared
line_texts.gap_statement: the run left this suspicion unchecked: {summary}
line_texts.no_draft_carries: no draft carries this walk receipt
line_texts.no_confirmation: the draft has no `confirmation` word; write `confirmation: unconfirmed` in it (the walk receipt lifts it from there)
line_texts.sibling_unconfirmed: another draft of this place, {draft}, still stands unconfirmed{reasons}: {doors}
line_texts.sibling_door_no_walk: add a `walk` entry citing {record} to it
line_texts.sibling_door_merge: merge it into {named} when it is the same bug
line_texts.sibling_door_leave: or leave it, and the close names this place as a gap
line_texts.no_line: no active register line of this place was recorded by the answering dispatch; `place_answers.py write --replace` lands it
line_texts.not_installed: the findings register is not installed
